title: fix(app-shell): a record page reads its audit history when the History tab is shown (objectui#13010 part 5)
body:
Part of #13010
Clause-②: no

Part 5 of the card: item 4's remainder, the History tab's audit read. Part 2 (`29c19cc`) moved the timeline, comment, mention-list and foot-attachment reads to on-view. Part 4 (the rail and the badge) is in flight on its own branch. #13010 stays open.

## What changes

`RecordDetailView` read `sys_audit_log` (`top=50`, ordered by `created_at desc`) on every open of a `trackHistory` object whose registry holds `sys_audit_log`, and then a `sys_user` `$in` lookup for the rows' authors. Its only consumer is the `record:history` node in the synthesized page's History tab, which gets the rows as `entries`. That tab is never the first one, so on a plain open nothing drew what the two reads fetched.

| Read | Caller | What draws it | On first paint? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sys_audit_log` `top=50` | `RecordDetailView`'s audit history effect | the synthesized History tab's `record:history` (host `entries`) | Only when `?tab=history` names it |
| `sys_user` `$in` (`top` = author count) | the same effect, after the audit answer | the same | the same |

The read now goes out when that node is on screen. The judgment reuses part 2's rule: `pageShowsNodeOnOpen`, with a `HISTORY_CONSUMER_TYPES` set holding `record:history`. There is no second copy of the active-tab rule. The History tab is added only in the late synth rebuild that carries the rows, so the view synthesizes the page once more for the judgment, with the History tab and no rows (`historyPage`). That is the same `buildDefaultPageSchema` call over the same slots. The History item's `value` is always `history`, and the first item is the same in both trees, so the verdict for that node matches the rendered tree.

- At open: read when `?tab=history` names the tab. Otherwise read on the tab switch that mounts it. The flag stays set for the view's life once the tab is shown, latched the way the feed's is.
- A strip the rule cannot read keeps the eager read, as in part 2. That covers a `tabs` slot replacing the synth strip, a `defaultTab` in either spelling, and a `visibleWhen` item.
- An **assigned** record page is rendered as authored (`composedPage` is `effectivePage`), and its own `record:history` self-fetches `sys_activity`. So these rows never reached any block there, and the assigned path no longer reads them (`historyPage` is null). Nothing it shows changes.
- **What the tab shows is unchanged:** the same rows and the same loading state. The commit that mounts the tab hands `record:history` `loading: true` (`historyPending`) until the effect's read starts. That way the tab never flashes "No history yet" before the read is issued.
- No new export, prop, type member or cache. `record-history.tsx` and `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` are unchanged; the read is owned by `RecordDetailView.tsx` alone. The `page:tabs` badge probes are unchanged.

## Measured (harness `RecordDetailView.recordOpenWaves-13010.test.tsx`)

This is the synthesized page of a `trackHistory` object with `sys_audit_log` registered, opened with no `?tab=`:

- **Before** (base `29c19cc`): 12 requests in 2 waves. Wave 1 had `sys_audit_log top=50` beside the record read. Wave 2 was `sys_user top=1`, the audit author lookup.
- **After** (`d1ec111451`): 10 requests in 1 wave. Neither read goes out.

Part 2's pages are unchanged: they hold no `trackHistory` object.

## Pins (new `describe` in the harness)

- (a) A `trackHistory` record opened on its Details tab issues neither `sys_audit_log` nor its `sys_user` lookup at open. The History tab trigger is present, so the silence is not a missing tab.
- (b) Opening the History tab reads `sys_audit_log` (`top=50`) once, after the open's requests, and runs the author lookup once. It draws the rows: the resolved author name and the diff value.
- (c) CONTROL: `?tab=history` reads `sys_audit_log` in wave 1 and the lookup in wave 2, and draws the same rows.
- (d) An assigned page of a `trackHistory` object, opened on its Activity tab, reads the feed but never the audit log.
- Part 2's pins in the same file stay green: 15/15.

**Ablation (one-off, not kept).** `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` from the objectstack checkout deleted the guard line `if (!historyWanted) return;`. On-disk proof: anchor count 1 to 0, blob `8abcb53b48f1` to `e96672f60021`. Run: (a), (b) and (d) red, 12 passed, including (c). Restore: the blob after restore is `8abcb53b48f1`, equal to the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The harness imports `RecordDetailView` from source, so no `dist/` sits in the path.

## Gates (on `d1ec111451` unless named)

- Closure build `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `--listFilesOnly` shows the test project reads the harness.
- vitest `--maxWorkers=1` under the shared lock:
  - Family files whose path names `record-history`, `RecordDetailView`, `recordOpenWaves-13010` or `buildDefaultPageSchema`, plus test files that name `trackHistory`: 80 files / 659 tests, all passed. This ran on `c3d5f644bc`; the later commit drops one redundant cast only.
  - The harness, `auditDisplayLocale-10442`, `feedGrant-12082` and `recordOpenRequests-12701`, rerun on `d1ec111451`: 4 files / 40 tests, all passed.
- **Declared to CI:** the full `packages/app-shell/` directory. The order rules out whole-package runs on the shared box.
- `pnpm lint`, narrowed to the 2 changed source and test files:
  - Result: exit 0, 0 errors. `RecordDetailView.tsx` carries 102 warnings, equal to the base blob's 102. The harness has 0.
  - Population: the root `eslint.config.js`, which the package's `eslint .` reads. File count: 2, from `--format json`.
  - Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move a verdict on any untouched file.
- Pre-tsc battery, each exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`.
- `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`: exit 0. `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0. `check:new-line-citations`: exit 0.
- `check:spec-floors`: exit 1. This is recorded, not fixed, as the order says. The diff touches no `package.json`.

## Acceptance notes

- "Shown" means mounted, as in part 2. A `record:history` on a strip the rule cannot read (a `tabs` slot, a `defaultTab`, a `visibleWhen` item) keeps the eager read. That is the conservative side.
- An authored `record:history` inside a synth slot matches the type and so may trigger the host read, which it never consumes because it self-fetches. That is the conservative side too, and no worse than before.
- Not browser-verified against a running stack. The harness drives the real page over the real adapter with a held transport.
